scope: Physical parameters in the declared parent-part frame; overall success remains the unchanged independent geometry/runtime test
part_offset: effective rest position = anchor + joint_frame @ local_position; no-joint position otherwise
joint_axis: undirected parent-frame axis line orientation; direction sign tested separately
direction_flip: same aligned signed parent-frame motion direction; a wrong axis cannot count as a corrected direction
joint_anchor: revolute anchor point distance to reference axis line; displacement along that line is physically equivalent
unknown: Non-executable program or unsupported source semantics -> null, retain in denominator and separately report coverage/bounds
initial_equivalence: Original finding already physically equivalent under the independent predicate -> null for every method; never award repair credit or remove the case
exposure: Initial per-finding visible Gold counterfactual evidence, frozen before model runs; rest9/motion42/unexposed3
interpretation: Strict original physical-parameter restoration, not perceptual tolerance or overall program correctness
